recentItems.title: MC Megacy, team walk from JHB to DBN to create awareness about children living with disabilities
recentItems.description:
Two South African men have taken on a 600-kilometre walk from Johannesburg to Durban to raise funds and awareness for children living with disabilities.

Molelekwa Mahoko, better known as content creator MC Megacy, alongside his teammates Vusumuzi Mbambani and Vusi Dodo, began their journey on September 1, with plans to reach Durban on October 1.

Their MegaWalk Foundation aims to raise funds and awareness, while inspiring people living with disabilities. 

We have been tracking their journey and they are now nearing their destination.

Joining us virtually to track their progress and reflect on the journey so far is Molelekwa Mahoko, known as Megacy

recentItems.title: 2nd annual Kagisano Horse Racing event in Ganyesa village
recentItems.description:
Horses are trickling in at the Ditshipi Farm for the annual Kagisano Horse Racing event in Ganyesa village in the North West.

This is the second annual event to be held in the area, aimed at embracing and promoting horse racing in rural areas.

Over 50 participants from more than 30 villages surrounding Ganyesa and neighbouring areas, including the Northern Cape, are expected to participate.

We're crossing to SABC News reporter, Zebilon Maine

recentItems.title: Zikhakhazise Ngesikhenu cultural event in KwaMhlanga, Mpumalanga: Nonhlanhla Ntshingila updates
recentItems.description:
SABC radio station Ikwekwezi FM is hosting its annual Zikhakhazise Ngesikhenu event in KwaMhlanga, Mpumalanga. 

The three-day event provides a platform for communities to showcase and experience different cultures through traditional music, dance, food, clothing and other forms of heritage. 

For more on this, we are now joined by SABC News Reporter Nonhlanhla Ntshingila.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: AmaHlubi Traditional Leader Nkosi Lutho Zibi on keeping heritage alive
recentItems.description:
As modern life continues to reshape our communities, there are growing questions about the traditions and values we may be leaving behind. 

How important is it to understand where we come from, and can our heritage still offer lessons for the challenges we face today?

From the role of families and traditional leaders to how younger generations connect with their cultural roots, we explore whether the values of the past can coexist with the realities of modern life, and what we risk losing if those traditions disappear.

To unpack this, we're joined by AmaHlubi Traditional Leader, Nkosi Lutho Zibi.

recentItems.title: LGE 2026 | PA Deputy President Kenny Kunene says the party is focused on delivering basic services
recentItems.description:
The Patriotic Alliance's deputy president Kenny Kunene says his party is focused on delivering basic services, creating job opportunities and fighting irregular migration.

The party is bringing its 2026 Local Government Election campaign to the heart of Mangaung on Saturday, with thousands of supporters gathering at the Dr Petrus Molemela Stadium in Bloemfontein.

Party leader Gayton McKenzie is delivering the keynote address as the PA unveils its manifesto ahead of the local government elections.

SABC News Reporter Ntlantla Kgatlhane is there with the latest.
